title: Unknown nested DXF TABLE bounded-skip fast slice
scope: Make structurally framed unknown nested TABLES entries observable without semantic publication
Bound the diagnostic storage and message when a drawing contains many unknown nested tables
Preserve malformed ENDSEC-before-ENDTAB and missing-ENDTAB rejection

method.limitations: Generated structure/framing tests only. They do not establish proprietary table semantics, binary values with unrecognized widths, CLI warning presentation, producer validity, or downstream application behavior.

implementation.behavior: A safely terminated unknown nested table is skipped. At TABLES completion or failure, one non-failing TABLES-phase unsupported-table-skipped diagnostic summarizes the run. It retains at most eight names, caps each name at 64 bytes, reports the total count, and reports omitted-name count. If the secondary diagnostic list is full, a non-failure advisory slot is reused; failure evidence is preserved.
positiveControls: ASCII and Binary DXF each contain 20 unknown nested tables followed by a known LAYER and a LINE sentinel
Unknown table bodies include a header handle, declared count, repeated known-width group values, APPDATA, XDATA, and a handle-valued tag
Read succeeds and known table/entity delivery continues
Diagnostic reports non-failing TABLES phase, 20 skipped tables, a retained name, and 12 omitted names
Diagnostic secondary-entry count remains within its fixed maximum
negativeControls: ASCII and Binary ENDSEC-before-ENDTAB inputs fail with BAD_READ_TABLES
ASCII and Binary missing-ENDTAB/EOF inputs fail with BAD_READ_TABLES
